literal_meaning: ঢেঁকি চলে গেল (the pestle went away)
figurative_meaning_bn: অনুরোধে অনিচ্ছা সত্ত্বেও কোনো কঠিন কাজের দায়িত্ব নেওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: Reluctantly taking on the responsibility of a difficult task upon request
example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রকল্পটি খুব কঠিন হলেও, বন্ধুর অনুরোধে সে ঢেঁকি গেলা করে দায়িত্ব নিল।
অফিসের সবাই এড়িয়ে যাওয়ায়, শেষ পর্যন্ত রাহুল ঢেঁকি গেলা করে অতিরিক্ত কাজটা সামলাল।
example_sentences_in_english: Though the project was very tough, he reluctantly took it on at his friend's request, like the dhinki going away.
When everyone else avoided it, Rahul finally shouldered the extra work grudgingly upon insistence.
history: This idiom originates from rural Bengali agrarian life, where the 'dhinki' (a wooden pestle for pounding rice) represents a burdensome tool; 'going' implies taking it up unwillingly, reflecting traditional village dynamics of shared labor.
note: Deeply tied to pre-modern rural tools and communal responsibilities in Bengal.
